subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands mounts a compact security camera onto an exterior wall bracket. The left hand holds the camera steady against the mounting plate while the right hand drives a screw into place with a cordless driver, a coiled teal wire lead dangling loose and ready to connect. The scene captures the precise, hands-on moment of a smart-home installer at work.
